customKeycodes.name: TB_LEFT_BTN
customKeycodes.title: Left trackball button. Acts as left mouse click. With 2 buttons, hold for drag DPI.

customKeycodes.name: TB_RIGHT_BTN
customKeycodes.title: Right trackball button. Right click. With 2 buttons, hold for scroll.

customKeycodes.name: TB_MID_BTN
customKeycodes.title: Middle trackball button. Tap for middle click, hold for scroll. Left plus right together toggles left handed mode.
